text: When the cupboard was opened, a loose shelf tipped forward, causing three folders to fall. Nothing was broken during the incident. The remaining folders were moved from the cupboard to a table, and a note was left to discourage others from using the cupboard. These actions removed the remaining folders from the affected cupboard and alerted other potential users to avoid it. The account does not indicate whether the loose shelf was subsequently inspected, secured, or repaired.
